$comment: Sample fsi_cbgcoveragegap rows produced by Copilot Billing Governance coverage-gap analysis (monitor-only). Illustrative only — keys are Dataverse LOGICAL column names (see docs/dataverse-schema.md). Option-set columns show the integer value Dataverse stores; the label is given in fsi_notes for readability. fsi_pathway: 100000000=none, 100000001=mcp-cs, 100000002=mcp-agentbuilder, 100000003=api-direct, 100000004=metered, 100000005=unmapped. fsi_blockreasonsummary: 100000000=No eligible cohort, 100000001=Missing license, 100000002=Zero-rating unresolved - fail-closed, 100000003=Not in credit scope, 100000004=Policy cap exceeded, 100000005=Unmapped pathway. fsi_spendscope: 100000000=Chat - Credit-eligible, 100000001=SharePoint - PAYG-only, 100000002=Mixed. One row per agent; fsi_blockedsampleupns is a capped sample to avoid row blow-up. UPNs are example identities, not real.

value.fsi_notes: pathway=none -> ALLOW (eligibility N/A); non-metered agent does not consume credits, so no coverage gap.

pathway=metered; 64 intended users are in no eligible billing cohort (dominant reason: No eligible cohort). Sample capped at fsi_CBG_CoverageGapSampleCap. Right-size the credit-scope group before enabling enforcement.

pathway=mcp-cs; 41 Copilot-licensed users are blocked fail-closed because the zero-rating conflict is unresolved (fsi_zeroratingresolved=false) and they are not in credit scope. Re-evaluate after the June 2026 Licensing Guide is published.
pathway=unmapped -> fail-open with anomaly; classifier could not map this agent, so users are not blocked. Flagged for triage so a detection defect does not silently deny access.
